figures.finding: Belarus gives full civil capacity at eighteen (majority).

value.earlier: marriage; or emancipation from 16 for one working under an employment contract or trading with consent (art. 26)

figures.applies: Civil Code art. 20, as amended to 2018; later amendments not read.

sources.said: возникает в полном объеме с наступлением совершеннолетия, то есть по достижении восемнадцатилетнего возраста.

figures.finding: From fourteen to eighteen a minor makes contracts with the written consent of a parent, adopter or guardian, but freely disposes of his own earnings and exercises his author's rights in his own literary or artistic work; at sixteen one working under an employment contract may be emancipated by the guardianship body with both parents' consent, or by a court. No share of earnings is set aside by law.

value.consent: written consent of parents, adopters or guardian
value.reachesWritingDirecting: yes: author's rights in his own work

figures.finding: Belarus reported that no employment contract may be made with anyone under sixteen; from fourteen, with a parent's, tutor's or guardian's written consent, a minor may do light work that doesn't harm health, development or schooling.
figures.applies: Belarus; the State's 2008 report on Labour Code art. 21 (renumbered since; the code's own text not read).

sources.said: Under article 21 of the Labour Code, no employment contract may be concluded with a person less than 16 years of age. With the written consent of a parent, tutor or guardian, a minor who has reached the age of 14 may be employed for light work
